reference_profile.game: Xemu startup identity (emulator reference, not a game)
reference_profile.inheritance: Blue energy emergence and central lockup timing only; no source pixels.
Legal VDP density as a workmanship pointer; no sprites, stages, or characters.
Original native pixel clusters and deliberate palette roles; no art or IP copying.

cinematic_direction.intention: Uma massa de energia azul se reúne e revela a assinatura SGDK Forge em uma tomada contínua de quatro segundos.
cinematic_direction.narrative_structure: Uma tomada contínua de quatro segundos: escuridão/silêncio, campo azul articulado, convergência legível, reveal SGDK em dois beats, FORGE subordinado, sweep direcional, hold e fade. O preview isolado termina em A: REVER; o perfil de handoff entra no menu após fade e drenagem DMA.
cinematic_language_methods: Tomada continua; BG_B permanece atras das placas BG_A durante a animacao.
64 particulas 8x8 nascem escalonadas e convergem para celulas 8x8 visivelmente ocupadas pela mascara WIP atual do SGDK.
A marca SGDK revela em dois beats de paleta: contorno azul entre F84-119; preenchimento claro entre F120-137.
FORGE entra abaixo de SGDK por fade-in e permanece subordinada.
Sete instancias 8x8 reutilizadas atravessam o lockup em uma diagonal curta.
O perfil preview reduz a luminância do fundo, preserva SGDK/FORGE, mostra A: REVER e espera BUTTON_A; o perfil handoff mantém input travado, espera fade/DMA e transfere ownership ao menu.
cinematic_direction.signature_moment: F118: cue de lock; F120: o campo de particulas se oculta e comeca o preenchimento claro; F138: o lockup SGDK completa a revelacao.

timeline_semantics.ranges: Global frame ranges are left-inclusive and right-exclusive.
timeline_semantics.input_policy: Nenhum skip durante os 240 quadros. Preview isolado: A: REVER reinicia após o hold. Perfil handoff: sem replay; espera conclusão do fade/DMA após F240 e entrega ao menu com input bloqueado por 12 quadros.
timeline_semantics.post_timeline_handoff: O segmento visual continua nominalmente [0,240); drenagem de DMA/fade pode estender o hold antes do menu. A duração efetiva precisa ser medida em ROM.

particle_profile_candidate.note: The current WIP choreography measures 13 sprites/104 pixels at the worst H40 scanline (frame 106), with 64 total sprite links. This is only local sprite geometry; the workspace measurement gate, total VRAM, DMA, CPU, DAC, sustained FPS and final art remain open.

states.narrative_purpose: Give the viewer a full beat of darkness and silence before energy exists.

states.narrative_purpose: Blue particles emerge in waves, expand from the center, then begin drawing inward.

entry_load.load_status: The three image tilesets are queued in image chunks and the eight particle-frame tilesets are queued one per update; preload completes by the end of frame 15. render_surfaces.SPRITES: seven 8x8 crystal sprites reused from the energy pool

states.exit_teardown: Hide the seven borrowed particle sprites at frame 210; retain both wordmark plates.

states.narrative_purpose: Settle the crystal field while retaining the luminous SGDK/FORGE lockup and a clear laboratory replay prompt.

entry_load.load_status: No new art tiles are loaded in this state; the V006 PAL0 field settles without fading the SGDK/FORGE palettes to black.

render_surfaces.BG_A: SGDK and FORGE lockup remain visible; A: REVER is drawn in the open gap below FORGE.
render_surfaces.BG_B: V006 crystal field remains visible at a cooler lower-luminance PAL0 hold palette.

palette_domains.role: V006 backdrop fades to sBackdropReviewPalette over the final 30 frames; index 0 stays black.

text_block.rendering: SGDK built-in VDP font, lab preview only, PAL3 index 15, tile column 16 and row 21; centered below FORGE with clearance from the lower flare.

dynamic_fx: 30-frame PAL0 transition from the V006 source palette to the cool lower-luminance preview hold palette.
At frame 240 stop audio, draw A: REVER at tile column 16,row 21 and wait for BUTTON_A.

motion_beats.purpose: Allow a final read of the full lockup.
Complete the selected V006 field fade, retain the lockup, then hold the replay hint for human review.
